files.workspace.css: .list-workspace{max-width:800px;margin-inline:auto;padding:20px;color:#202b3a}.list-workspace header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.list-workspace button{font:inherit;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #9da9ba;border-radius:6px;background:white;color:inherit}.list-workspace button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #365dc9;outline-offset:2px}.list-workspace li{padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #d8dde5;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.list-error{padding:16px;border:2px solid #ae3434;border-radius:8px;background:#fff4f3}.empty-list{padding:32px 16px;text-align:center;border:1px dashed #8994a5}.list-workspace [role=status]{min-height:1.5em}
